description: Pakistan's electricity regulator publishes the country's only plant-level power data as Excel-exported HTML that reads as empty and PDFs nobody extracts — this turns it into a queryable panel and names every gap.

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: The determinations feed. REQUIRES gzip: without Accept-Encoding this page silently truncates under a 30 s timeout and returns a partial list under an HTTP 200.

tools.name: fca_list
tools.description: The consolidated FCA table. Coverage is hard-bounded Jul-2018 to Jun-2022; negatives are written in accounting parentheses.

tools.name: generation_index
tools.description: The site's own generation index. INCOMPLETE — links 5 of the 7 reachable years; never use as the sole enumerator.

tools.name: generation_year
tools.description: Fetch one fiscal year's generation workbook payload. windows-1252 encoded; the HTTP header declares no charset. Required: fy.

params.name: fy
params.description: Fiscal year as published, e.g. 2023-24 (reachable: 2017-18 through 2023-24)

tools.name: hydel_list
tools.description: Hydel data. Dependable capacities are pinned upstream to 'July 2018 - June 2022'.

tools.name: licence_list
tools.description: The licence register accordion. Key lookup must be typo-aliased: the page misspells its own column as 'Gross Capacityy', hiding the largest entry.

tools.name: quarterly_list
tools.description: Quarterly index. FROZEN upstream at 'April 2022- June 2022 (4th Quarter)' with 'Not Yet Issued' against every DISCO; nothing on the page says it is stale.

tools.name: reliability_report
tools.description: Fetch one Performance Evaluation Report PDF. Filenames are unconstructible across years — always scrape from sources, never build the path. Required: path.

params.name: path
params.description: Report path under /Standards/ as discovered by sources; one known filename carries a load-bearing trailing space

tools.name: sir_get
tools.description: One State of Industry Report, returned as PDF bytes. Very large: 2025 is ~316 MB. Required: year.

params.name: year
params.description: Report year, e.g. 2024. Reports 2004 through 2025 are HEAD-verified.

tools.name: tariff_get
tools.description: One DISCO's tariff page. UTF-8 on this surface, unlike the generation workbooks. Rate schedules themselves are image-only PDFs and are NOT extractable. Required: disco.

params.name: disco
params.description: Distribution company name as it appears in the tariff path, e.g. LESCO, MEPCO, HAZECO

novel_features.name: Plant-month generation extract
novel_features.description: Pull every power plant's monthly generation and utilisation for a fiscal year as rows you can pipe, with unreported months kept distinct from real zeros.

novel_features.name: Operator and ticker fleet panel
novel_features.description: Follow one plant or a listed operator's whole fleet across the fiscal years the crosswalk has observed, through renames and re-sorted row numbers.

novel_features.name: Conflict and break ledger
novel_features.description: List every place NEPRA's own published figures disagree — two sources on one key, an unexplained step inside a single series, or a row that fails its own arithmetic — showing both values and both citations without picking a winner.

novel_features.name: DISCO reliability panel
novel_features.description: Per-distribution-company transmission losses, recovery, interruption frequency and duration against the regulator's own targets, across report years.

novel_features.name: Regulatory determination feed
novel_features.description: A dated feed of tariff determinations and orders by company, distribution company or docket, with the verbatim document link.

novel_features.name: Generation licence register
novel_features.description: The licence register with gross capacity, plant type, fuel and the modification trail, searchable by name or fuel.

novel_features.name: Fetch and staleness gate
novel_features.description: Assert every published NEPRA surface against status, byte floor, content checksum, in-document year token and the frozen column fingerprint, exiting non-zero when stale or drifted.

novel_features.name: Capacity by status and system
novel_features.description: Installed and dependable capacity broken out by plant status and system, so each headline megawatt figure is labelled and derivable.

novel_features.name: Fuel cost adjustment series
novel_features.description: The monthly requested-versus-allowed fuel cost adjustment series with cumulative disallowance, bounded to the window the source actually covers.

novel_features.name: Source catalogue and enumerator diff
novel_features.description: Catalogue every reachable published document with size, coverage window, text-layer flag and reachability state, and diff it against the shipped manifest.
